Stage 1 component distributions. The rna layer. Facets show components 1-2 in decomposition
order; stored densities summarize sample-coordinate distributions; rugs mark sample
coordinates; dotted vertical lines mark zero; Rug colours encode continuous weeks. The analysis
unit is biological observation nested within a complete subject trajectory; the design is
longitudinal; the estimand is the descriptive distribution of sample coordinates; time is
recorded as weeks in weeks; subjects are identified by mouse_id. No component-selection
threshold is applied. This descriptive gallery does not rank or nominate a biological
coordinate.
